name: L.D.C. S.A.
summary: L.D.C. S.A. produces, sells, and exports poultry products in France, Poland, Spain, and internationally. The company operates in Poultry and Convenience divisions. It is involved in breeding pork, cattle, and rabbits; collecting cereals and agricultural supplies; producing, sorting, packaging, and selling eggs; and slaughtering activities. The company also offers fresh and frozen foods, including ready meals, pizzas, pancakes, exotic meals, and sandwiches; and pastries, quiches, tarts, pies, cooked meats, and sauces. In addition, it provides poultry-cuts and processed products, as well as other kinds of poultry, such as ducks and geese. The company offers its products under the Le Gaulois, Maître CoQ, Loué, Marie, and Traditions d'Asie brands. L.D.C. S.A. was founded in 1968 and is based in Sablé-sur-Sarthe, France.
